findings: [bug] macros/adapters/default/sessions/snowplow_sessions_tmp.sql:69 Trailing comma after exit_page_url when no pass_through_columns

judge.reason: Finding 0 identifies the same defect at the same location. The commit added a trailing comma after exit_page_url and moved the pass-through column loop after it. With the default empty pass_through_columns list, the select ends in a comma before from, so the SQL is invalid. It does not mention the multi-column case where the max(...) expressions run together, but the labelled bug's core mechanism, the trailing comma with the default empty list, is the same.
